fomod.Name: More Stress Gone
fomod.Author: Rusted-1
fomod.Description: Patches that let more things from other mods lower your stress in Stress and Fear. 1.0.0 adds Glad You're Here: hugging someone lowers your stress by 5 (followers, strangers, pets), 10 (good friends), 18 (spouse or lover) or 25 (your children).
